native_runtime.backend: NVIDIA DSparkWorker with PCG/checkpoint graph adapters and TensorRT compute

environment_requirements.CUDA_HOME: the CUDA 13.2 toolkit directory for the native environment
environment_requirements.LD_LIBRARY_PATH: include native environment lib and lib/openmpi

engine_reuse: same GPU model, TensorRT 11.3.0.99, model/calibration hashes and IO contracts; validate load and a real head on the destination
precision_policy: shared per-role protected BF16 list; separately calibrated static FP8 or INT8 SmoothQuant; RNN FP32, KV unchanged
assets: models, engines, calibration artifacts, timing caches and environments remain outside Git
validation_scope: seven new-checkpoint first-chunk routes:5warmups/30waves/15seconds serving power; floating audit reporting only
